# Baltan

> Explainable Redis / Valkey diagnosis. Read-only Docker agent. Port 6379 never opens to Baltan.

## Site

- Home: https://baltan.xyz/
- Why is Redis slow?: https://baltan.xyz/why-is-redis-slow
- Redis high memory: https://baltan.xyz/redis-high-memory
- Missing TTLs: https://baltan.xyz/redis-missing-ttl
- Big keys: https://baltan.xyz/redis-big-keys
- Don’t use MONITOR: https://baltan.xyz/redis-monitor-dangerous
- vs RedisInsight: https://baltan.xyz/redis-vs-redisinsight
- Privacy: https://baltan.xyz/privacy
- Terms: https://baltan.xyz/terms

## Product

Baltan is not a Redis GUI. It answers operational questions (latency, memory pressure, eviction, expensive commands) with findings and evidence from sanitized telemetry.

Contact: hello@baltan.xyz
